note: Production order, batching and caps for pose sets. It names pose FAMILIES (posture_activity, e.g. standing_talk); the catalog (assets/characters/pose-catalog.json) supplies each family's directions, variants and tiers, so nothing is duplicated here. Read by assets/characters/poses/tools/pose_planning.py. A catalog family that no group names is NOT dropped: it is appended automatically as the last group 'catalog-additions' so a newly added pose becomes visible to the planner without editing this file. This file plans work; it records no approvals, no progress and no hashes.

defaults.batching: Groups stay intact. A group larger than max_batch is split into equal-sized batches (11 jobs become 6 + 5, not 8 + 3); a small group stays a small batch (min_batch 1). Raise min_batch only if you want small groups joined with the next one. Users may override max_batch, directions and group.

groups.title: Surprise, nerves, sadness and looking down
Inspecting, peeking, drinking, looking out, warming hands (catalog tier 4)
Lying poses (artwork only; the game cannot place them until beds can be walked on)

reference_policy.note: No catalog tier-4 pose exists for any character (every tier-4 entry is 'not_generated'), so no approved SAME-POSE reference exists yet. Each family below lists PROPOSED nearest approved poses. None is confirmed: a job in an unconfirmed family is reported as 'needs a reference decision' and gets no prompt. To confirm, the user sets confirmed to true (or supplies an external reference image and says so). A confirmed nearest-pose reference is described to the image tool as a NEAREST pose, never as the same pose. Once an example character (Char for the first pass) has an approved version of a tier-4 pose, later characters use that same-pose image automatically.

standing_inspect.advice: Bent forward toward an object; the look-down and table-reach poses are the closest approved bodies.

standing_peek.advice: A lean around cover has no close approved relative; an external reference (photo or sketch) is recommended.

standing_drink.advice: Raising a cup; an external reference is recommended.

standing_look_out.advice: Looking toward a window, north-facing only; the look-up pose is close.

standing_warm_hands.advice: Hands held toward a fire; an external reference is recommended.

kneeling_inspect.advice: Kneeling inspect is planned for east, south and west only (north is excluded).
kneeling_inspect.action_note: The action to draw is inspecting (looking closely at the floor or an object), not reaching.
kneeling_inspect.label: nearest related pose

confirmed_by.words: Yes, confirm same-direction kneeling reach as the nearest-pose reference for kneeling inspect East, South, and West. Use it for composition and kneeling posture only; keep the action specifically about inspecting. Label it “nearest related pose,” not “same pose.” This confirms the reference policy only; generated images still need my review and approval.
confirmed_by.scope: Confirms this reference policy only. Generated images still need the user's review and approval.

seated_talk.advice: Seat contact from seated idle, gesture from standing talk.

seated_write.advice: Same seat and posture as seated read, writing hand instead of a book.

catalog_entry_fields.note: Optional fields a catalog entry may carry; absent means the default. Adding an entry creates a planned job for every eligible character; it never creates an approval and never implies every character needs it.
required: directions (or body_axis and head_direction for lying)

optional.eligible_characters: list of slugs, or omit for everyone
optional.exclude_characters: list of slugs to leave out
optional.reuse_from: pose_id this entry reuses (no new image; reported as accounted for, never as missing)
optional.excluded: true plus a reason: leave the entry out of every plan
